lsfate.harmonia.hook: The blessing of one who binds the scattered into a single melody.
lsfate.harmonia.lore: She matches her allies' steps and lifts their strength, forging those who fought apart into one formation. When the deep melody of the Barbiton rings out, every strength resonates as one, and it lights a path to fight together through any darkness.
lsfate.harmonia.name: Harmonia
lsfate.harmonia.passive: +10% movement speed to nearby allies - starts with the basic kit
lsfate.hecate.hook: The blessing of one who stood at the crossroads with a dying ember.
lsfate.hecate.lore: On the night the dark swallowed the world, she alone raised a torch. When Hesperos cuts the air a curse is carved into the enemy's shadow, and that brand burns on every ally's blade. Weakest alone, she makes those beside her strongest.
lsfate.hecate.name: Hecate
lsfate.hecate.passive: Basic attacks brand the cursed - starts with the basic kit
lsfate.nemesis.hook: The blessing of one who returns in kind the force she is given.
lsfate.nemesis.lore: She does not dodge; she turns every blow aside and gathers momentum from it, pouring that force whole into her edge. The instant Adrasteia swings, everything she has gathered breaks loose as a single stroke and cuts through all before her.
lsfate.nemesis.name: Nemesis
lsfate.nemesis.passive: +5 armor, +3 armor toughness, Momentum - starts with the basic kit
